articles.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

articles.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
articles.snippet: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.snippet: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
articles.snippet: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

articles.title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
articles.snippet: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.
